next.reason: The owner accepted JPL-001 after automated checks and mobile review. The next bounded slice is recording what was wrong and what the learner learned.

ownerSummary.whatIsBeingBuilt: A private local JavaScript practice log that preserves the learner's attempt, mistakes and lessons before AI provides a solution.
ownerSummary.whyThisTaskNow: The create-save-reload slice is complete and accepted. The next learning risk is whether the learner can turn a failed attempt into an explicit mistake and lesson without adding AI, scoring or review scheduling.
ownerSummary.whatNotToDo: Do not start retry scheduling, mistake analytics, backend, authentication, sync, AI hints, code execution or gamification during JPL-002.
ownerSummary.whatComesAfter: JPL-003 may add a fresh retry flow only after the mistake-and-lesson reflection is implemented, verified and accepted.
